result.finding: Java 8 (source/development), targeting Java 21 JRE (Eclipse Temurin) for containerized production deployment. The application is built with Maven using Spring Boot 2.7.18 framework. Both the web and worker modules are Spring Boot fat JARs executed via 'java -jar'.
evidence: scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh: generated Dockerfiles use 'FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine' — Java 21 JRE runtime in containers
web/pom.xml and worker/pom.xml: spring-boot-maven-plugin for fat JAR packaging
Entrypoint: ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "app.jar"] — standard Spring Boot JAR execution
README.md: Prerequisites: JDK 8 required for running locally
